camera.internal_stop: Video capture stopped on an internal error.
camera.label: Camera:

decimals.label: Decimals: {value}

detect.add_tip: Create one area measurement per object (undo with Ctrl+Z)
detect.exclude_border_tip: Objects cut by the edge of the image or zone would be measured incompletely
detect.fill_holes_tip: Holes inside objects count in their area
detect.original_note: Computed on the original image: brightness/contrast are ignored.
detect.smooth_tip: Light smoothing before thresholding, against noise
detect.title: Detect objects
detect.too_many: Too many objects ({n}, maximum {max}): raise the minimum area or adjust the threshold
detect.zone_tip: Select a rectangle, area or circle to limit detection to it
dialog.export_series_csv: Export the measurements of the whole series
dialog.export_svg: Export the annotated image as SVG
filter.bicubic_tip: 4 × 4 pixels. The fastest reconstruction filter; a slight ripple remains along edges.
filter.bspline_tip: Prefilter over the whole image, then 4 × 4 pixels. Very even edges, almost no halo.
filter.gpu_tip: No resampling: the original pixels are copied as they are, so the staircase of tilted edges stays visible.
filter.lanczos3_tip: 6 × 6 pixels. Very sharp, close to ideal reconstruction; a faint halo may appear on high-contrast edges.
filter.shear_tip: Three one-dimensional passes with a 16-pixel sinc. The most faithful, but the slowest and the most memory-hungry.
group.no_groups: No group yet: type a name
hint.angle.first: Click a point on the first side of the angle
hint.angle.second: Click a point on the second side — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.angle.vertex: Click the vertex of the angle — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.annot.typing: Type the text · Enter or click elsewhere to confirm · Esc to cancel
hint.arc.first: Click one end of the arc
hint.arc.last: Click the other end of the arc
hint.arc.middle: Click a point along the arc
hint.area.first: Click the first vertex of the area
hint.area.next: Click the next vertex — double-click, Enter or click the first point to close
hint.area.second: Click the next vertex — Backspace: remove the last point
hint.arrow.base: Click the base of the arrow (where its text goes)
hint.arrow.tip: Click the point the arrow aims at
hint.circle.center: Click the center of the circle (or drag from the center to the edge)
hint.circle.edge: Click a point on the edge of the circle
hint.circle3.first: Click a first point on the edge of the circle
hint.circle3.second: Click a second point on the edge
hint.circle3.third: Click a third point on the edge
hint.ellipse.axis: Click the end of the first semi-axis (sets the tilt) — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.ellipse.center: Click the center of the ellipse
hint.ellipse.width: Click to set the second semi-axis — Shift: circle
hint.length.first: Click the first point (or drag from end to end)
hint.length.second: Click the second point — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.line_angle.first: Tilt: click the start of the first segment (or drag from end to end)
hint.line_angle.first_end: Click the end of the first segment — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.line_angle.second: Click the start of the second segment, anywhere (or drag from end to end)
hint.line_angle.second_end: Click the end of the second segment — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.parallel.first: Parallel gap: click the start of the reference segment (or drag from end to end)
hint.parallel.point: Click a point on the other edge: the parallel line goes through it
hint.parallel.second: Click the end of the reference segment — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.path.first: Click the first point of the path
hint.path.next: Click the next point — double-click, Enter or right-click to finish, Backspace: remove a point
hint.path.second: Click the next point — Backspace: remove the last point
hint.perspective.dialog: Enter the real dimensions of the rectangle if you know them — or click four other corners
hint.perspective.first: Perspective: click the first corner of an object that is rectangular in reality (plate, sheet, façade…)
hint.perspective.fourth: Click the fourth corner: the photo will be reprojected so that this quadrilateral becomes a rectangle
hint.perspective.second: Click the second corner — the order of the corners does not matter, Backspace removes the last one
hint.perspective.third: Click the third corner — Esc to give up
hint.point_line.first: Point-line distance: click the first point of the line (or drag along the line)
hint.point_line.point: Click the point to measure; the line is extended as needed
hint.point_line.second: Click the second point of the line — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.profile.first: Click on one side of the line to measure (or drag across it)
hint.profile.second: Click on the other side, straight across the edges — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.rect.first: Click a first corner (or drag diagonally)
hint.rect.second: Click the opposite corner — Shift: square
hint.rect3.first: Click the first corner of a side (or drag along the side)
hint.rect3.second: Click the other end of the side — Shift: horizontal/vertical/45°
hint.rect3.third: Click to set the width — Shift: square
hint.scale.dialog: Enter the real length in the dialog — or draw another segment
hint.scale.end: Click the end of the known length — Shift: horizontal/vertical
hint.scale.start: Scale: click the start of a known length (or drag from end to end)
hint.select.drag_handle: Release to place the point — Shift: constrain
hint.select.idle: Click a measurement to select it — drag empty space: pan, wheel: zoom
hint.select.selected: Drag a handle to edit, the line to move — Del: delete, Esc: deselect
hint.straighten.end: Click the end of the line: the photo will rotate to make it horizontal or vertical
hint.straighten.start: Straighten: click the start of a line that should be horizontal or vertical (or drag from end to end)
hint.text: Click where the text goes, then type it (Enter to confirm)
io.is_dir: this is a folder, not a file
msg.detect_live: Detection runs on a frozen image: capture the live frame first
msg.image_unavailable: Image {n} is no longer available and cannot be saved.
msg.images_missing: Images not found: {n}. Their measurements are kept.
msg.images_unreadable: Files that could not be read as images: {n}
msg.live_mismatch: Resolution {w} × {h} has another aspect ratio: existing measurements and scale no longer match the image
msg.live_other_camera: The scale was set with another camera: check it
msg.paste_nothing: Nothing to paste: copy an image or an image file first
msg.perspective_invalid: These four points do not form a convex quadrilateral: click the four corners of one rectangle.
msg.perspective_live: Perspective is corrected on a frozen image: capture the live frame first
msg.perspective_no_scale: Perspective corrected — now set the scale (Scale tool)
msg.profile_live: The intensity profile is measured on a frozen image: capture the live frame first
msg.series_export_failed: Images that could not be exported: {n}. {detail}
multi.clear: Keep only the current measurement selected
multi.delete_tip: Delete all selected measurements (Ctrl+Z to undo)
open.new_tip: Removes all open images to start from scratch. Ctrl+Z restores them with their measurements.
panel.by_group_tip: Show the list and statistics group by group
panel.copy_tip: Copy the measurement table, to paste into a spreadsheet
panel.empty_help: Pick a tool on the left, then click on the image.
panel.export_csv_tip: Save the measurements to a CSV file (Ctrl+E)
panel.scale_remove_tip: Go back to pixels (undo with Ctrl+Z)
panel.scale_set_tip: Draw a segment of known length on the image, then enter its real length.
panel.scale_unset: Not set: measurements are in pixels.
persp.estimated: Without dimensions, the proportions are estimated from the perspective (uncropped photo) and the scale will still have to be set.
persp.exact: These dimensions set the proportions of the rectangle and the scale of the measurements.
persp.incomplete: Enter both the width and the height, or leave both fields empty.
persp.intro: The photo will be reprojected so that the quadrilateral you marked becomes a rectangle. The original file is not modified, and Ctrl+Z undoes the correction.
persp.real_size: Real dimensions of the rectangle, width × height (optional):
persp.title: Correct the perspective
presets.apply_tip: Apply this scale to the image (undo with Ctrl+Z)
presets.keep: Keep the scale for the next image
presets.keep_tip: An added image that does not follow the shared scale of the series (other dimensions, option off) takes the current scale, as does the first image of a new work. A project always restores its own scale.
presets.menu_tip: Save the scale under a name and reapply it to other images
presets.need_scale: Set the scale first to save it as a preset.
presets.replace_tip: A preset with this name exists: its scale will be replaced
presets.save_tip: Save the current scale under this name (Enter)
profile.band_tip: Width of the strip, on either side of the segment, over which the intensity is averaged. A wider band reduces noise; keep it within a straight part of the line.
profile.export_tip: Save the intensity curve and the detected edges as a CSV file.
profile.linear_tip: Measures the light itself rather than the values stored in the file, so that a blurred edge stays centred on its true position. Untick for an image that is already linear (scientific camera).
profile.method.gradient_tip: Each edge is taken where the intensity changes fastest. More sensitive to noise, but better for a line barely wider than the blur or under uneven lighting.
profile.method.half_tip: Each edge is taken where the intensity crosses the level halfway between the two plateaus around it. The most repeatable choice when the line is clearly wider than the blur.
profile.no_edges: Fewer than two edges detected: lower the threshold, widen the band or lengthen the segment.
profile.perpendicular_tip: When the segment is not drawn exactly across the edges, the width is brought back to the perpendicular. The tilt is estimated from the two halves of the band (at least 4 px wide).
profile.pick_hint: Dashed lines: other detected edges. Click one to use it in place of the nearest selected edge.
profile.strongest_tip: Go back to the two most marked edges.
profile.threshold_tip: An intensity change counts as an edge when its slope reaches this share of the steepest one. Automatic: 25 %, raised if the image is noisy.

project.newer_data: this project contains data ({field}) that this version of MeterOscope does not know and would lose when saving; please update MeterOscope
project.not_project: this is not a MeterOscope project
project.not_utf8: this is not a UTF-8 text file
project.several_images: this project holds a series of images, which this version of MeterOscope cannot open; please update MeterOscope
project.unknown_version: unknown project format version {version} (this version of MeterOscope reads up to version {max}); please update MeterOscope
recent.title: Recent files
report.title: Measurement report
reticle.label: Reticle:
scale_bar.needs_scale: Drawn once the scale is defined
scale_bar.show_tip: Drawn on the view and on the exported image
series.own_scale_tip: This image keeps its own scale instead of following the scale of the series.
series.remove_tip: Removes the image and its measurements from the project (Ctrl+Z brings them back). The file is not deleted.
series.shared_scale: Same scale for the whole series
series.shared_scale_tip: Setting or changing the scale on one image applies it to all the others.
stats.empty: They will appear here after the first measurement.
stats.title: Statistics
status.perspective_tip: The photo is displayed reprojected into the plane of the marked object; the original file is not modified. Double-click: remove the correction.
status.rotation_tip: Display rotation of the photo (straightening); the image and measurements are not modified. Double-click: reset.
table.name: Name
tool_help.angle: Angle from three points: one side, the vertex, the other side.
tool_help.arc: Arc through three points (end, middle, end): radius of curvature, arc length, central angle, chord.
tool_help.area: Area and perimeter of an outline; double-click to close.
tool_help.arrow: Point at a detail with an arrow, with optional text at its base.
tool_help.circle: Circle from its center, then a point on its edge.
tool_help.circle3: Circle through three points on its edge.
tool_help.ellipse: Ellipse by its center and two semi-axes, tilted with its round handle: major and minor axes, area, perimeter.
tool_help.line_angle: Tilt between two segments, even far apart (0°: parallel, 90°: perpendicular).
tool_help.parallel: Gap between a reference segment and the parallel line through a point: thickness or width of a band, without aiming perpendicularly.
tool_help.path: Length of a polyline; double-click to finish.
tool_help.perspective: Click the four corners of a rectangular object photographed at an angle: the photo is reprojected to square it up, and measurements become true across its whole plane.
tool_help.point_line: Perpendicular distance from a point to a line through two points, extended if needed.
tool_help.profile: Width of a line, a slot or a track from its intensity profile: draw a segment across it, the two edges are located to sub-pixel accuracy.
tool_help.rect: Width, height and area, from two opposite corners. When selected, tilt it with its round handle.
tool_help.rect3: Tilted rectangle: two points for one side, a third for the width.
tool_help.scale: Draw a segment of known length to set the scale.
tool_help.select: Select, move or edit a measurement.
tool_help.straighten: Draw a segment along a line that should be horizontal or vertical: the photo is displayed straightened, without being modified.
tool_help.text: Write a free label on the image (not a measurement).
toolbar.detect_tip: Detect and measure objects automatically by thresholding (particles, grains, cells, holes…)
toolbar.export_pdf_tip: A4 pages: annotated image, scale, measurements and statistics
toolbar.export_svg_linked_off: Only for an image saved unchanged in a file, without perspective correction
toolbar.export_svg_linked_tip: Small file that refers to the photo on disk (brightness and contrast settings are not applied to it)
toolbar.export_svg_tip: Vector measurements over the photo, embedded in the file: edit them in Inkscape or Illustrator
toolbar.open_tip: Open an image or a project (Ctrl+O). An image is added to those already open; a project replaces them.
welcome.drop: … or drop an image into the window
welcome.paste_tip: Screenshot or image copied from a browser (Ctrl+V)
welcome.tagline: Measure lengths, angles and areas on an image.
